set S := { (p k : ℕ × ℕ) | p.Prime } with hS_def
  have hS_inf : Set.Infinite S := by
    rw [hS_def]
    refine ⟨fun ⟨p, k⟩ hpk => ⟨p + 2, 0⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Nat.prime_two_add_two (Nat.Prime.add_one p.Prime)
    · exact ⟨p + 2, 0, Nat.prime_two_add_two (Nat.Prime.add_one p.Prime)⟩
  have hS_pos_dens : 0 < S.lowerDensity := by
    rw [hS_def]
    have h := Nat.exists_infinite_primes 2
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hP_prime⟩ := h
    refine ⟨P, 0, ?_⟩
    simp only [Nat.cast_le, Nat.cast_zero]
    <;> norm_num
    <;> omega
  simpa [hS_def] using hS_pos_dens
